forwardBin.description: The facility-layout location code of the forward bin.

available.description: `onHand - reserved`; can be negative when reservations exceed the bin.

minQty.description: Absent when the face has no policy.

maxQty.description: Absent when the face has no policy.

openRequestId.description: The open request of this face; absent when none.

status.description:
`BELOW_MIN`: the projected level is at or below the minimum. `OK`: above
it. `NO_POLICY`: no policy declared. `NO_SOURCE`: low, but nothing can be
moved (no reserve bin holds usable stock, or less than one `multiple` fits).
status.title: PickFaceStatus

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, or an invalid path, query or header parameter.

schema.description: RFC 7807 problem document used for every non-2xx response.
schema.title: Problem

malformedBody.summary: Malformed JSON body or unknown field

value.title: Malformed request
value.detail: request body is not valid JSON for this operation

value.title: Policy is invalid
value.detail: minQty must be at least 0 and below maxQty, and multiple at least 1

value.title: Request id is invalid
value.detail: request id must start with repl- and have no whitespace, control characters or '/'

value.title: If-Match is invalid
value.detail: If-Match must be a policy version, a non-negative integer

value.title: State is invalid
value.detail: state must be one of Requested, Completed, Cancelled

value.title: Status is invalid
value.detail: status must be one of BELOW_MIN, OK, NO_SOURCE, NO_POLICY

value.title: Cursor is invalid
value.detail: cursor is not a value returned by this API

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: send an Idempotency-Key header with a unique value per logical request
